text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan was injured during training,
so we rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... I am relieved that a trip to the hospital
will not be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "If it required hospital visits, my family might have insisted I be hospitalized to rest my legs."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
From my experience so far, I know my body well.
Now is not the time to rest just yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I have knowledge of rehabilitation.
May I resume training within reasonable limits?"
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself is far too dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I have knowledge of rehabilitation.
May I resume training within reasonable limits?"
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself is far too dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Dangerous... Yes, indeed.
Even though I barely managed to avoid a hospital visit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry,
I lost my composure."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I will get plenty of rest todayand focus entirely on healing my injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounding disappointed,
Mejiro Ardan slowly made her way back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Having your cooperation, Trainer,
is truly reassuring.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...One... two, thr—kuh...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm barely putting any strength into it,
and yet a sharp pain shoots through..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed... I took things too lightly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but right now I think I should
concentrate on letting my injury heal...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Voicing her frustration,
Mejiro Ardan headed back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Two more... one more... phew~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That exercise was to maintain muscle mass and flexibility.
...What a relief, it seems I can move my body like this without any issue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's move on to the next routine, then.
I'll be very careful not to strain you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan trained within reasonable limits,
taking her past injuries into careful consideration.
